IC_harness_anchor.value_note: this harness scores waves 2..6 (240 checks); mesh3 scored 2..4 (144); zero fails on the superset
IC_harness_anchor.margin_note: margin_at_commit is an INSTANTANEOUS sample at the commit instant (signal slope ~5-10 mV/ps): the OFFSET_TABLE Amendment-2 class that is not cross-engine interchangeable below ~1%; rel diff reported as measured

t_level_ps.method: depth-12 chain @2 fF, (t_cross(stage10)-t_cross(stage4))/6 at VDD/2, 2 ps input edge; worst of both-inputs-switching and one-input-tied-high; VACASK primary, Xyce alongside
